All signs.voice_body: STOP, pause, and taste the sweet clarity of today. The Sun and Venus have joined in a perfect dance, a cazimi that brightens everything. This union is a symbolic invitation to love yourself and shine brightly—your inner light and the light you give to others. Let the warmth of that conjunction remind you that confidence and kindness can coexist. Use that radiance to set a simple intention: write down one thing you love about yourself and share it with a friend. This act will echo the harmony of the planets and anchor the day in real, tangible joy.
